description: This file contains the implementation of the UserService class, providing read operations for user data via asynchronous methods, interacting with a user repository.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Provides read operations for users, implementing IUserService interface.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID asynchronously and returns a UserDto model if found.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all users asynchronously and returns a list of UserDto models.
